confirm.delete_one: Are you sure you want to delete the selected broadcast?
confirm.delete_other: Are you sure you want to delete the {{count}} selected broadcasts?
confirm.pause: Pause this broadcast? Nobody new will be sent to. Anyone already sent to is unaffected, and going live again continues where it stopped.
confirm.resume: Continue this broadcast? It picks up where it stopped.
confirm.send-now: Send this broadcast now? It will not wait for the moment it was scheduled for.
confirm.cancel-schedule: Cancel this schedule? The broadcast goes back to being a draft and will not go out on its own.

toast.duplicated-body: A draft copy is ready to edit
toast.paused-body: The broadcast stopped taking new recipients
toast.schedule-cancelled-body: The broadcast is a draft again
toast.scheduled-body: The broadcast goes out on its own
toast.schedule-failed: Saved as a draft, but could not be scheduled

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.body: A broadcast sends a message, or runs a flow, once for every customer you target.
empty.filtered-body: Nothing here fits the filters above. Loosen one to see more.

notification.total-body: Customers matched by the selected tag who are eligible for this campaign.
notification.sent-body: Client portal users who successfully received the notification.
notification.read-body: Recipients who opened and marked the in-app notification as read.
notification.push-body: Campaign was configured to deliver mobile and web push notifications.

workflow.total-body: Customers matched by this campaign’s audience when it was last run.
workflow.started-body: Customers the flow was started for. A step that waits or delays can run for days afterwards, so what happened next lives in the flow’s own history.

email.total-body: The cumulative count of all email messages processed during this broadcast.
email.send-body: The handoff to {{provider}} was successful and delivery is now being attempted.
email.delivery-body: The email was successfully accepted by the recipient’s incoming mail server.
email.open-body: The recipient viewed the message content within their specific email client.
email.click-body: The recipient interacted with one or more tracked hyperlinks in the email.
email.complaint-body: The recipient received the email but manually flagged the message as spam.
email.bounce-body: The recipient’s mail server permanently rejected the message delivery attempt.
email.renderingfailure-body: The email was not sent due to a technical error within the template syntax.
email.reject-body: The email was scanned by {{provider}}, found to be a risk, and blocked.
email.deferred-body: The receiving server asked for the message later. Nothing has failed — but a number climbing here is the provider holding this campaign back.

stat.skipped-body: Recipients the run decided against — unsubscribed, no address, already reached by an earlier run, or gone.

recipients.no-flow: No flow ran for this person yet.
recipients.empty-body: The people this campaign targets are written down when it goes live.

recipientEmail.unavailable: This message cannot be rebuilt — the run or the contact is gone.
recipientEmail.no-events-yet: Sent. The provider has not reported anything yet.

traces.empty-body: Traces will appear here once the broadcast starts sending.

schedule.in-past: Pick a moment that has not passed yet.
schedule.dialog-body: It goes out on its own, and stays editable in between.

workflow.after-selected: Pick what runs after the selected step.
workflow.each-step: Each step runs once for every customer this campaign reaches.
workflow.none-body: A workflow campaign builds its own automation when it is created.
workflow.step-settings: What each step is set to
workflow.requirements: These have to exist in this organization before the flow can run.
workflow.no-requirements: Nothing to set up — this flow runs on what you already have.
workflow.write-yourself-body: Installing works without these, but the flow is not finished until they are filled in.

method.loop-body: The flow runs once for every customer in the segment or tag you picked, one run each.
method.draw-body: Add actions from the canvas beside this panel. The Start node stands for the customer each run receives.
method.live-body: A campaign with an empty flow cannot go live, so add at least one action before setting it live.

dryRun.empty: This campaign has nobody to rehearse on yet.
dryRun.unresolved-body: These reached the body as written. Every one of them would have gone out as text.
